title: vectorProfile
description: The profile of a did:vector record, as the resolver shows it in didDocumentMetadata.vectorProfile. The chain holds name, description, framework, endpoint and capabilities as UTF-8 bytes. The resolver adds createdAt as UTC text, and protocol, which is not on chain. The resolver leaves out an empty value and a text that is not valid UTF-8, so no member is required. Every text is a statement of the record holder: nothing on the chain checks what it says. The limits below are the widest that either registry accepts, so this schema accepts every profile that the resolver shows. A record of the identity registry has narrower limits: the description of each member names them. A new member needs a new version of this schema.

name.description: On chain. A record of the identity registry holds 1 to 64 bytes of UTF-8. A legacy record holds up to 256 bytes. maxLength counts characters and the chain counts bytes, so the limit is a necessary check and not a sufficient one.

description.description: On chain. A record of the identity registry holds up to 256 bytes of UTF-8. A legacy record holds up to 1024 bytes. maxLength counts characters and the chain counts bytes.

framework.description: On chain. A record of the identity registry holds up to 64 bytes of UTF-8, for example custom. A legacy record holds up to 128 bytes. maxLength counts characters and the chain counts bytes.

endpoint.description: On chain. A record of the identity registry holds up to 256 bytes of UTF-8. A legacy record holds up to 512 bytes. The text is normally an https URL, but the chain checks the length only, so this schema asserts no URI format. A subagent has no endpoint. maxLength counts characters and the chain counts bytes.

protocol.description: Not on chain. The protocol that the resolver detected at the endpoint in a background job.

capabilities.description: On chain. A record of the identity registry holds up to 16 identifiers of 1 to 64 bytes each, without duplicates. A legacy record holds up to 32 items of up to 128 bytes each, and the chain checks neither duplicates nor empty items. maxLength counts characters and the chain counts bytes.

createdAt.description: UTC time in whole seconds. For a record of the identity registry: the creation time that the record holds. For a legacy record: the block time of the legacy mint.
